statement: Define alpha_i(lambda) as the linear R10 Yukawa-template coefficient of residual component R_i after the calibrated Newtonian 1/r channel is removed.
Because the template projection is linear on the residual force/potential channel, the projected tail coefficient is the sum of projected component coefficients.
The conservative finite gate uses absolute components, so cancellation between hidden/source/boundary/transition pieces is not allowed.
If Xi components are stored as these dimensionless alpha_i coefficients, then K_NH, K_edge, K_tr and Pi_R10 are not independent physical constants.
equation: K_NH=K_edge=K_tr=Pi_R10=1 in the dimensionless R10 alpha norm

statement: Raw action-space residuals cannot use the unit constants until projected and normalized against the same calibrated source/test geometry.
equation: raw R_i -> alpha_i(lambda) required before R10 scoring
